import os,sys,json,time
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot

RUN='/app/runs'
r=Robot()
cam='robot0_eye_in_hand'

def sense(save=None,cameras=None,depth=False):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or [cam],include_depth=depth,video='none')
    if save:o.save(f'{RUN}/{save}')
    return o

def qpose(o):
    p=dict(zip(o.meta['proprio']['layout'],o.meta['proprio']['now']))
    q=np.array([p[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
    xyz=np.array([p[f'eef_right_{x}'] for x in 'xyz'])
    rot=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
    return q,xyz,rot,p

def act(q,grip=-1,n=20,note='',save=None,cameras=None,base=(0,0,0),torso=0,mode=-1):
    a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=q;a[:,7]=grip;a[:,8:11]=base;a[:,11]=torso;a[:,12]=mode
    o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=cameras or [cam],include_depth=False,video='none',note=note)
    if save:o.save(f'{RUN}/{save}')
    if cam in o.meta['cameras']:
        _,x,_,_=qpose(o)
        print(note,'q',np.round(q,3),'eef',np.round(x,3),'time_left',round(o.meta['time_left_s']))
    return o

def calibrate():
    o=sense('calib_initial');q0,x0,C0,p=qpose(o)
    print('start',q0,x0)
    J=np.zeros((6,7))
    for i in range(7):
        q=q0.copy();q[i]+=.07
        o=act(q,n=25,note=f'calib_joint_{i}',save=f'calib_{i}')
        q1,x1,C1,_=qpose(o)
        dx=x1-x0;drot=R.from_matrix(C1@C0.T).as_rotvec()
        J[:,i]=np.r_[dx,drot]/(q1[i]-q0[i])
        print(i,'diff',np.round(dx,4),np.round(drot,4),'actual dq',q1[i]-q0[i])
        o=act(q0,n=25,note='calib_return')
    np.savez(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz',J=J,q=q0,x=x0,C=C0)
    print('J',J)

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='calibrate':calibrate()

def move_xyz(target,orient=None,grip=-1,max_iter=25,tol=.012,n=25,prefix='move'):
    target=np.array(target,float)
    data=np.load(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz')
    J=data['J'].copy();Cgoal=data['C'] if orient is None else orient
    o=sense();q,x,C,p=qpose(o)
    for k in range(max_iter):
        ep=target-x; er=R.from_matrix(Cgoal@C.T).as_rotvec()
        print(prefix,k,'x',np.round(x,3),'err',np.round(ep,3),'rot',np.round(er,3),flush=True)
        if np.linalg.norm(ep)<tol and np.linalg.norm(er)<.1:break
        W=np.diag([1,1,1,.25,.25,.25])
        e=np.r_[ep,er];jw=W@J;ew=W@e
        dq=jw.T@np.linalg.solve(jw@jw.T+.01**2*np.eye(6),ew)
        dq=np.clip(dq,-.18,.18)
        if np.linalg.norm(dq)>.27:dq*=.27/np.linalg.norm(dq)
        qcmd=q+dq
        oldq,oldx,oldC=q.copy(),x.copy(),C.copy()
        o=act(qcmd,grip=grip,n=n,note=f'{prefix}_{k}',save=f'{prefix}_{k:02d}')
        q,x,C,p=qpose(o)
        a=q-oldq;b=np.r_[x-oldx,R.from_matrix(C@oldC.T).as_rotvec()]
        J+=(np.outer(b-J@a,a))/(a@a+1e-8)
    np.savez(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz',J=J,q=q,x=x,C=C)
    return o

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='move':
        move_xyz(list(map(float,sys.argv[2:5])),prefix=sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv)>5 else 'move')

import os,sys,json,time
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot

RUN='/app/runs'
r=Robot()
cam='robot0_eye_in_hand'

def sense(save=None,cameras=None,depth=False):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or [cam],include_depth=depth,video='none')
    if save:o.save(f'{RUN}/{save}')
    return o

def qpose(o):
    p=dict(zip(o.meta['proprio']['layout'],o.meta['proprio']['now']))
    q=np.array([p[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
    xyz=np.array([p[f'eef_right_{x}'] for x in 'xyz'])
    rot=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
    return q,xyz,rot,p

def act(q,grip=-1,n=20,note='',save=None,cameras=None,base=(0,0,0),torso=0,mode=-1):
    a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=q;a[:,7]=grip;a[:,8:11]=base;a[:,11]=torso;a[:,12]=mode
    o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=cameras or [cam],include_depth=False,video='none',note=note)
    if save:o.save(f'{RUN}/{save}')
    if cam in o.meta['cameras']:
        _,x,_,_=qpose(o)
        print(note,'q',np.round(q,3),'eef',np.round(x,3),'time_left',round(o.meta['time_left_s']))
    return o

def calibrate():
    o=sense('calib_initial');q0,x0,C0,p=qpose(o)
    print('start',q0,x0)
    J=np.zeros((6,7))
    for i in range(7):
        q=q0.copy();q[i]+=.07
        o=act(q,n=25,note=f'calib_joint_{i}',save=f'calib_{i}')
        q1,x1,C1,_=qpose(o)
        dx=x1-x0;drot=R.from_matrix(C1@C0.T).as_rotvec()
        J[:,i]=np.r_[dx,drot]/(q1[i]-q0[i])
        print(i,'diff',np.round(dx,4),np.round(drot,4),'actual dq',q1[i]-q0[i])
        o=act(q0,n=25,note='calib_return')
    np.savez(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz',J=J,q=q0,x=x0,C=C0)
    print('J',J)

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='calibrate':calibrate()

def move_xyz(target,orient=None,grip=-1,max_iter=25,tol=.012,n=25,prefix='move'):
    target=np.array(target,float)
    data=np.load(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz')
    J=data['J'].copy();Cgoal=data['C'] if orient is None else orient
    o=sense();q,x,C,p=qpose(o)
    for k in range(max_iter):
        ep=target-x; er=R.from_matrix(Cgoal@C.T).as_rotvec()
        print(prefix,k,'x',np.round(x,3),'err',np.round(ep,3),'rot',np.round(er,3),flush=True)
        if np.linalg.norm(ep)<tol and np.linalg.norm(er)<.1:break
        W=np.diag([1,1,1,.25,.25,.25])
        e=np.r_[ep,er];jw=W@J;ew=W@e
        dq=jw.T@np.linalg.solve(jw@jw.T+.01**2*np.eye(6),ew)
        dq=np.clip(dq,-.18,.18)
        if np.linalg.norm(dq)>.27:dq*=.27/np.linalg.norm(dq)
        qcmd=q+dq
        oldq,oldx,oldC=q.copy(),x.copy(),C.copy()
        o=act(qcmd,grip=grip,n=n,note=f'{prefix}_{k}',save=f'{prefix}_{k:02d}')
        q,x,C,p=qpose(o)
        a=q-oldq;b=np.r_[x-oldx,R.from_matrix(C@oldC.T).as_rotvec()]
        J+=(np.outer(b-J@a,a))/(a@a+1e-8)
    np.savez(f'{RUN}/jacobian.npz',J=J,q=q,x=x,C=C)
    return o

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='move':
        move_xyz(list(map(float,sys.argv[2:5])),prefix=sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv)>5 else 'move')

def joint_path(qtarget,grip=-1,n=100,note='joint_path',save=None):
    o=sense();q,x,C,p=qpose(o)
    a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=np.linspace(q,qtarget,n);a[:,7]=grip;a[:,12]=-1
    o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=[cam],video='none',note=note)
    if save:o.save(f'{RUN}/{save}')
    print(note,'eef',np.round(qpose(o)[1],3),'q',np.round(qpose(o)[0],3),'time_left',round(o.meta['time_left_s']),flush=True)
    return o
